messages:
maria_g: Heads-up — seeing a spike of 10xx errors from POST /v1/generate in prod-west. gpu-v2b pool is flapping. Can someone enable a short-circuit fallback for that route to model-compact-1? Putting this here so oncall sees it.

ashley_p: Which metric are you looking at? p95 latency or 5xx count?

rahul: 5xxs. Last 5m error rate ~7%, p95 jumped but p50 still fine. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/routing/prod-west :eyes:

tomk: @oncall_jen can you take this? If yes, flip the short-circuit flag for route `POST /v1/generate` to point at `model:compact-1`. Use admin API and follow runbook checks.

oncall_jen: On it. Will follow the short-circuit runbook.

liao: Runbook checklist (short):
1) Validate traffic slice (prod-west, route /v1/generate)
2) Flip `route.short_circuit` for that route to `model:compact-1`
3) Watch 5xx, p95, and throughput for 10m
4) If stable -> convert to canary (10% traffic) then promote.

liao: Example admin command (use $ADMIN_TOKEN and confirm):

```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/api/v1/routes/short_circuit" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","toggle":"on","target":"model:compact-1","reason":"hotfix: gpu-v2b flapping"}'
```

liao: And rollback: `{"toggle":"off"}` or revert weights to previous variant. Also clear prefix cache if keying differs.

deploy-bot: change_event: route.short_circuit toggled ON for /v1/generate by oncall_jen at 2334509910 (id: evt-7b9f).

oncall_jen: Toggled short-circuit ON to model:compact-1. Watching now.

rahul: Seeing immediate drop in 5xx to ~0.6%, p95 down ~220ms. Logging shows fallback model responses are healthy.

maria_g: Good. Note in incident ticket: why we chose compact-1 (lower mem pressure, known stable quantization), TTL for fallback (15m), and verification queries. Also check prefix/KV cache not poisoned.

liao: If new errors appear after the toggle, rollback steps:
- curl admin toggle off
- revert route weight config: `admin routes set-weight /v1/generate gpu-v2b:100`
- run `admin cache invalidate --prefix '/v1/generate'` if you see key-mismatch errors

oncall_jen: Will hold for 30m then either promote to canary or rollback. Leaving monitors up. :thumbsup:

srebot: Scheduled health checks every 60s for 30m; will post aggregate at end.

tomk: Follow-up: add short-circuit section to runbook and add a console UI confirmation modal that lists impact (expected latency, cost delta, affected customers).

ashley_p: Can we also add a telemetry alert that fires when 5xx > 5% AND model pool flapping > 3 mins? That would make this more automatic next time.

maria_g: Agreed. Create a small ticket for telemetry + runbook UI task after this incident.

oncall_jen: ack. keeping thread open until 2334509930 to ensure no regressions.

maria_g: Thanks everyone. Good, fast ops.

(End of thread)
